subject: sel
title: Walking in their shoes
blurb: Read, then understand how a friend feels.

config.title: Kofi at Break Time
config.passage: At break time, Kofi dropped his lunch on the ground, and it could not be eaten. He sat by himself in the corner, looking down and saying nothing, while the other children laughed and played nearby.

questions.prompt: How does Kofi most likely feel?
How can you tell how he feels?
choices: he is alone and looking down

questions.prompt: Understanding how another person feels is called:
The kindest thing to do is:
choices: ask if he is okay and share some food
tell him to cheer up, then leave
